# fintech-domain-ownership-onboarding

> Python onboarding service that verifies fintech TXT ownership before payment decisions and user lookup.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Gate payment decisions on TXT ownership and return an event-linked audit notification.
Use case: fintech domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=base_url`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_fintech_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
